title: Global well-posedness for 3D incompressible magneto-micropolar fluids without resistivity and spin viscosity in strip domains
summary: The global existence of classical solutions to the 3D compressible magneto-micropolar fluid system without resistivity and spin viscosity in a strip domain was recently established by Feng, Hong, and Zhu [Sci. China Math., 2024]. While Lin and Xiang [Sci. China Math., 2020] established global well-posedness for the 2D incompressible counterpart, the global well-posedness for the 3D incompressible case remains open. The analysis is rendered difficult by three major obstacles which are further compounded in the 3D case: the degeneracy induced by the lack of magnetic diffusion and spin…
